QuestInfo.name: Your First Informant Assignment
QuestInfo.0: Now that you have an idea of what an informant does, it's time to get your hands dirty. #b#p1002104##k will tell you what to do.
QuestInfo.1: Your first assignment is to find out why the #o1210102#s near #m100000000# are acting so wild. #p1002104# tells you to ask #b#p1300007##k, the mushroom monster scholar of #b#m100000000##k, if he can shed some light on what's been going on.

0.0: Now that you have an idea of what an informant does, shall we begin the real mission? Let's start it off somewhere easy...which means...yes, #b#m100000000##k.
0.1: Do you know about #m100000000#? It is the town where the Bowmen come out from the Six Path Crossway, just east of #m104000000#. It is also the center of Victoria Island. The town's specialty are Mushrooms.
0.2: But lately, the #o1210102#s near #m100000000# have been causing trouble. If you find out the reason behind this mess, the information should prove to quite lucrative. Head over to #m100000000# and ask around to gather information on #bthe abnormal behavior of these mushroom monsters#k.

yes.0: I know just the person to ask. Dr. #b#p1300007##k in #m100000000# studies mushroom monsters. Ask him, and we can get an idea of what's going on. I'll leave it up to you!\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Hmmm... are you too nervous to venture into other towns? No worries! Just like #m104000000#, #m100000000# is a town catered toward beginners. No high-level monsters there at all.

npc.0: You didn't go to #m100000000# yet? Visit the #bRegular Cab in Victoria#k on the right side of #m104000000#. You'll get there in a flash!
